description: Deletion AUC, insertion AUC, AOPC and pointing game for the already-computed CLIP ViT-B/32 patch-level Partition SHAP values of images I1-I10.
target_score: cosine(CLIP image embedding of the perturbed 224x224 input, CLIP image embedding of the original input); the original input scores 1
ranking: the 49 ViT-B/32 patches (7x7 of 32x32 px) ordered by |patch SHAP| descending, ties by patch index
masking: a removed patch is replaced by the same 128x128 box-blurred image that SHAP used as its masker background (source box_blur + patch_mask + compose)
curve_steps: one patch per step, k = 0..49, x = k / 49

pointing_game.box_source: author-annotated target-object boxes (drafted without seeing the SHAP maps, reviewed and approved by the author on 2026-09-30); the image dataset itself has no boxes or masks
pointing_game.point: centre of the highest-|SHAP| patch (the first patch of the ranking), mapped to original-image pixels
pointing_game.note: Hit = the point lies inside at least one approved box of the image's target (box clipped to the CLIP centre crop, enlarged by the tolerance). Accuracy = hits / evaluated images.
